display.title: Yud-Beis Tammuz: Ready to Give His Life for Children's Torah
display.summary_short: A short Yud-Beis Tammuz talk: the Frierdiker Rebbe's release from prison, and his readiness to sacrifice his life so that Jewish children could learn Torah.
display.summary_long: A short Yud-Beis Tammuz talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given the day after the holiday. Uncle Yossi recalls that on Yud-Beis Tammuz the Frierdiker Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneerson, was freed from prison when his life was truly in danger, saved by a miracle of Hashem. We thank Hashem for those miracles and pray that He show miracles again in our time and free us from golus. The Rebbe set himself as an example for all generations: his love of Torah was so great that he was ready to give his life so that Torah would be studied everywhere in freedom. His mesiras nefesh was especially for young children, the soldiers of Tzivos Hashem, so that they would learn Torah with true yiras Shamayim.
display.lesson: The Frierdiker Rebbe was ready to give his life so that children would learn Torah with yiras Shamayim.
